title: Shkadov Stellar Thrusters Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Shkadov Stellar Thrusters: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Shkadov Stellar Thrusters — moving entire stars with giant mirrors over eons.

Phase 1 — Prove (stellar sails): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (thruster propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (orbital mechanics): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (statite control): mirror arrays as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and stellar neighborhood-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
